note: The question set MorningLabs AI measures itself on. Copy this file and replace the domains and questions with your own. Never edit a question in place: a reworded question is a new question, so give it a new id and bump the version.
names_note: How your company is written in an answer's text. Used to report being named without being cited. Defaults to the first label of our_site.
lookalikes_note: Domains of other organisations whose names resemble yours. Listed only so that a citation to them is never counted as yours. Add one only when a run actually shows an engine citing it. Empty here on purpose.
groups_note: Which question ids feed which number. Questions added after your first run go in added_since_baseline, so the first numbers stay comparable.
